notes.title: Release stream: watch the developer play and talk
notes.notes: On July 13th, we invite all of you on a special journey: A stone carver on a quest to rescue his beloved while he got amnesia. An adaptation of #persian poetry & #mythology. A #love letter from IMGN.PRO & Black Cube Games to you all.
